BiblicalUsage: ʼIzqa is the signet-ring, the king's own seal. When Daniel was thrown to the lions, the king sealed the mouth of the den with his signet and the signets of his lords, so that no one could change what had been done to Daniel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sealed stone is part of the point: men shut Daniel in, but the seal could not shut God out.
